properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for validating PAM approval workflow for privileged access
properties.description: An approval workflow (see PAM workflow guideline) must be in place to manage privileged access to cloud resources. The responsible approver or manager must be aware and accountable for authorizations that are provided by the admin consent workflow. Privileged access approval must validate justification of the request, and the permissions and time period requested are appropriate.
